race.comment: ALWAYS AT THEBANK (4) showed improvement when second-up last start, finishing second at this circuit and distance. Should be nearing peak fitness now. Leading hope. OUR ECLIPSE STARZZ (5) hasn't raced for a year but has joined leading trainer Luke McCarthy in that time. Readied with two nice trials so could make a winning return. CLOSE SHAVE (7) draws wide but may be ready to improve after debuting with a respectable fifth in stronger company. KYCORDEN (10) draws on the back row but has been about the mark of late and must be respected, the latest offering a sound third at this circuit and distance.
